n1c_emu.name: n1c_emu
n1c_emu.definitions:
catch          centre distance <= 0.35 m for 3 consecutive control steps (0.3 s)  (ChaseEnvCfg)
    pursuer out    the pursuer's centre > 0.30 m beyond the tape, or flipped
    evader out     the evader's centre > 0.30 m beyond the tape (with no catch or pursuer out first)
    ram            body contact (separating-axis gap < 1 cm) while the pursuer's own speed toward the evader > 0.3 m/s
